limitations.greg_threads: Greg exposes no documented per-call thread option. It is repeated on every requested-thread row, but its effective native thread count is uncontrolled and is reported as such.
limitations.platform: This round qualifies macOS and Linux/SCC only; Windows remains deferred.
limitations.saved_fe_cross_command: Each command is checked against its own residual identity. Cross-command saved-predictor distances remain diagnostic because reghdfe uses a weaker saved-FE stopping rule than fereg.
limitations.stata_license: reghdfe and Stata-side work are capped at the licensed/machine processor limit. fereg receives the requested native thread count through 16 independently of the Stata license.
